notes.title: Important update!
notes.notes:
Last week, we announced our new upcoming game: Automobilista - Motorsports Simulator. www.game-automobilista.com . The game will be free to all existing owners of Stock Car Extreme, so long as you bought or have your copy activated here on Steam, all you have to do now is wait for it to become available!

For those who do not yet own Stock Car Extreme, today January 5th 2016 is the last day to buy it for its current price and also ensure a free copy of Automobilista. By its release, Automobilista will be priced US$ 39.99.

Starting tomorrow January 6th, Stock Car Extreme will have its base price dropped from US$ 29.99 to US$ 19.99 - however from then on it will no longer warrant a free copy of Automobilista.

So if you still don´t own Stock Car Extreme and are looking for a great deal, make sure to grab it now!

Metalmoro MR18 Preview & Release Update!
notes.notes:
Below we have a video preview of the LMP Metalmoro MR18 running at dusk at Taruma for your eyes! The car will be available very shortly to users of the game on both Steam and for those with current installs via GSCSync!

Existing owners who wish to convert there install to Steam will be able to get their GSC Extreme Steam key by Tuesday! There will be a page live on the official Game Stock Car website

Tomorrow 09/02 will be the last day to buy GSC outside Steam and still be able to retrieve a Steam key. From 10/02 onwards, while it will remain available outside Steam, new purchases will not longer warrant a Steam key.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9rRQvIIen3g

notes.title: STATUS UPDATE
notes.notes:
STATUS UPDATE (it has been a while): After some headaches, we are finally set to release Formula Truck 2013 & Game Stock Car Extreme on Steam. Both titles are being updated and are currently undergoing betatesting, we hope to have it all ready before the end of the month. Here´s a little teaser to show you we might have been quiet, but still working hard!

While we are at it, best wishes to all our fans for the new year - 2015 promises to be very exciting for simracing, we will certainly make our contribution to that end :)


STATUS UPDATE (já faz um tempinho) Depois de algumas dores de cabeça, finalmente estamos prestas à lançar o Formula Truck 2013 & Game Stock Car Extreme no Steam. Ambos games serão atualizados estão passando por betatesting, esperamos ter tudo pronto até o final do mês. Aqui um pequeno teaser para mostrar que apesar do silêncio, o trabalho segue firme!

Aproveitando a oportunidade, desejamos à todos nossos fãs um excelente ano novo - 2015 promete ser um grande ano para o automobilismo virtual, e nós certamente faremos a nossa contribuição para isto 

https://fbcdn-sphotos-d-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xap1/t31.0-8/10818390_10153040358672743_8183066883796406871_o.jpg
